newsitem.title: CHINA: SOCCER-SHANGHAI PICK BULGARIAN STOICHKOV AS COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SHANGHAI PICK BULGARIAN STOICHKOV AS COACH.

text.p: Shanghai's professional soccer team has picked Bulgarian Gordan Stoichkov as its coach, the Liberation Daily said on Sunday.
Shanghai Shenhua, national champions in 1995 and second this year, signed Stoichkov on a one-year contract and he was due to arrive in the city on December 15, the newspaper said.
The club had also signed one Bulgarian player and planned to sign two more who would play in the team under Stoichkov, it said.
Stoichkov played for Locomotiv Sofia, was coach of the Bulgarian under-16 team and coached a team in Tanzania and two teams in Bulgaria, it said.
Shenhua's current coach, Xu Genbao, has announced he will not renew a three-year contract that expires early next year and that he will coach the Guangzhou Songre team from 1997.
